title: Re-Arranging What the Snowsports School Laid On for the Old Date
content:
Whatever the Snowsports School laid on for the old date has to be laid on again for the new one, so a handling amount is added to a change of date by the number of add-on entries standing against the booking.

**Clause 1.** The handling amount for re-arranging what the school laid on is worked out only once the school account carries the add-on entry due for the lift access the session date requires.

**Clause 2.** Where two or more add-on entries stand against the booking, the multi add-on handling of 30.00 USD is added. Where exactly one add-on entry stands against it, the single add-on handling of 18.00 USD is added. Where no add-on entry stands against it, no handling amount is added, and the amount stands at 0.00 USD.

## Entries standing and the amount added

| Add-on entries standing against the booking | Handling amount added |
| --- | --- |
| 3 | 30.00 USD |
| exactly 2 | 30.00 USD |
| exactly 1 | 18.00 USD |
| none | 0.00 USD |

What is counted is the add-on entries standing on that booking's school account, of whatever kind of add-on; entries standing against another booking of the same household account are not counted.

## Illustrations of clause 2

- A booking against which a rental add-on entry and a lunch add-on entry stand carries a handling amount of 30.00 USD.
- A booking against which a single add-on entry stands carries 18.00 USD.
- A booking against which nothing stands as an add-on carries nothing on this count.
